Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL Staphylococcus aureus in culture. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are also present. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Glucosuria is noted and should be correlated with blood glucose. Clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
